items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Then we had Frank Mutz on piano. And that band... we changed the name to the Dixieland Romers.

ctx.x: Yeah. I didn't know that. He played wonderful clarinet. I never heard him play clarinet. Sure. Well he died now. Then we had Frank Mutz on piano. And that band, we changed the name from the Six Nola Jazzes, or New Orleans, Liliana Jazzes, we changed the name to the Dixieland Romers. And according to time, we were the first band to broadcast live on the old Crystal sets, radios, the Dixieland Romers.
